d:
Jim Jones ne logon ko ek aisi duniya ka sapna dikhaya jahan sab barabar honge aur kisi ke saath bhedbhav nahi hoga. Lekin Guyana ke ghane jangalon mein basa Jonestown dheere-dheere ek aisi jagah ban gaya, jahan logon ki zindagi par khauf aur control haavi hone laga.
Loudspeakers par goonjti awaazein, bandookon ke pehre aur ek aisa aakhri din jisne duniya ko hila diya. Aakhir Peoples Temple ke naam par shuru hua yeh sapna 900 se zyada logon ki maut ki traasdi mein kaise badal gaya?
Dekhiye Sannata,
